name: Backups
description: Backs up your chats, attachments, settings and keybindings to Google Drive or S3-compatible storage, encrypted on this machine with your passphrase.
longDescription: Copies the server's state, attachments, settings and keybindings, encrypts the copy on this machine, and uploads only ciphertext to Google Drive or any S3-compatible bucket. Includes scheduled backups, verification, and a restore that p0code confirms before swapping files in on restart.
